gloss: attributive form; adnominal form (of a Japanese verb or adjective)

definitions.explanation: One of the six traditional conjugation bases ({活用形|かつようけい}) of Japanese verbs and adjectives: the form that directly modifies a following noun. In modern Japanese this form is identical to the {終止形|しゅうしけい} for verbs and i-adjectives, but differs for na-adjectives (e.g., {静|しず}かな{部屋|へや}) and the copula.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修飾|しゅうしょく}→修飾：00460_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連体形|れんたいけい}です。
examples.english: The form that modifies a noun is the attributive form.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だ」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連体形|れんたいけい}です。
examples.english: "Shizuka na" is the attributive form of "shizuka da."

examples.japanese: ⟦{古文|こぶん}→古文：17172_kobun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連体形|れんたいけい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{終止形|しゅうしけい}→終止形：23611_shuushikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In classical Japanese, the attributive form and the terminal form were distinguished as separate forms.

notes:
A technical term from traditional Japanese grammar ({国文法|こくぶんぽう}). Composed of {連体|れんたい} ("linking to a body [noun]") + {形|けい} ("form"). Functionally, this is the form a predicate takes when it attaches directly to a noun as a modifier.

USAGE:
- For verbs and i-adjectives, the {連体形|れんたいけい} is identical in shape to the ⟦{終止形|しゅうしけい}→終止形：23611_shuushikei⟧ in modern Japanese: ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧, ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧.
- For na-adjectives, the {連体形|れんたいけい} ends in 〜な: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧.
- For the copula だ, the {連体形|れんたいけい} is な or (more formally) ⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧.
- Any clause that modifies a noun (a "relative clause") ends in the {連体形|れんたいけい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連体形|れんたいけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧: to conjugate into the attributive form
- ⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修飾|しゅうしょく}→修飾：00460_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{連体形|れんたいけい}: the attributive form that modifies a noun
- {連体修飾|れんたいしゅうしょく}: noun modification (by a clause or adjective)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{終止形|しゅうしけい}→終止形：23611_shuushikei⟧: terminal form — identical in shape for verbs/i-adjectives in modern Japanese
- ⟦{連用形|れんようけい}→連用形：16646_renyoukei⟧: continuative form — modifies verbs/predicates
- ⟦{未然形|みぜんけい}→未然形：23610_mizenkei⟧: irrealis form
- ⟦{仮定形|かていけい}→仮定形：24811_kateikei⟧: hypothetical form
- ⟦{命令形|めいれいけい}→命令形：22948_meireikei⟧: imperative form
- {連体詞|れんたいし}: adnominal — a part of speech that only functions attributively (e.g., ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧, ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧)
